page: Google Cloud Platform c4-standard-24-lssd is a general-purpose server powered by an Intel Xeon 6985P-C processor with x86_64 architecture. It features 24 dedicated vCPUs across 12 physical cores with 2.0 threads per core, running at a clock speed of 2.3 GHz. The processor includes a 504 MB L3 cache, 2 MB L2 cache, and 48 KB L1d cache. The system is configured with 90.0 GB of RAM, providing 3.75 GB of memory per core. It also includes 1343 GB of local NVMe SSD storage across 4 drives, with no bundled GPUs or complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

Benchmark results show strong performance in specific single-threaded and multi-threaded workloads. The server achieves top-tier performance in single-threaded gzip compression at 36.95 GB/sec, single-threaded bzip3 decompression at 15.24 GB/sec, and Geekbench single-core testing at 2309.0. Multi-core performance is strong, with a Geekbench multi-core score of 16269.0 and image processing score of 16192.0. Memory bandwidth reaches 2029.07 GB/sec for cached small-block reads, while large-block uncached reads and writes perform at 157.84 GB/sec and 65.29 GB/sec, respectively.

This server is well-suited for static web serving, which registers a strong throughput of 46.34 GB/sec, and database operations, supported by a Passmark database score of 13337.03 and Redis SET performance of 47.75 million operations per second. It is also capable of handling lightweight machine learning tasks, demonstrating top-tier text generation speeds of 365.79 tokens per second for a small 135M LLM. However, it exhibits poor performance for larger models, dropping to 2.39 tokens per second for a 70B LLM. The combination of dedicated compute resources, balanced memory, and high-speed local NVMe SSD storage makes it a cost-efficient option for workloads requiring high-speed local caching, software compilation, and medium-scale database hosting.
